name: FND_SAVED_SEARCH_USER_DFLT
description: This table captures the current default saved search for a user.  This value overrides any defaulting logic based on FND_SAVED_SEARCH_B data.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: USER_NAME - The user associated to the saved searches defaults

columns.name: CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description:
CONTEXT_CODE - A striping attribute that keeps one set of saved searches distinct from another.

Exampe: 'CRM', 'HCM'.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: OBJECT_TYPE - a sub classification of CONTEXT_CODE for striping saved searches.

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_ID
columns.description: SAVED_SEARCH_ID - unique id for saved search

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
